text:
maria_g: Heads up — I'm OOO starting 11:30 PT, handing oncall to @jon_dev. FYI: postmortem PM-42 (cache repop) still has an open remediation. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/314

jon_dev: Thanks, taking it. Can you paste the repro steps and the check you want me to run?

maria_g: repro steps below — quick smoke you can run in prod (low-risk):
```
# check current cache miss rate
curl -s 'https://metrics.redwood.ai/api/v1/query?query=cache_miss_rate' | jq .data

# simulate short-burst traffic from staging (adjust count for prod caution)
ab -n 100 -c 10 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
I saw miss_rate spike to ~12% after deploy-2026-02-10. SRE rolled a retry patch (02/11) but PM-42 lists "verify in prod under burst" as remaining.

alex_sre: I observed the same spike in us-west-2 around 03:14 UTC. Patch reduced tail latency but burst miss persisted for ~10–12m. I've put a note on PM-42 to require a 30m stable window under synthetic burst. If miss_rate > 5% for 15m, we should reopen.

sarah_pe: I can run a controlled load test in staging (10k qps for 2m) and post results here. Will do in ~30m.

oncall-bot: deploy/infra v2.3.1 rolled out by @ci-bot at 2026-02-11T03:20Z :white_check_mark:

jon_dev: OK running the prod check now (low impact): `kubectl get pods -n infra -o wide` and watching cache_miss_rate. Will also tail relevant logs: `kubectl logs -n infra -l app=cache-gateway -f --tail=200`

jon_dev: quick update — observed miss_rate hovering 2–3% for the last 30m after a small canary traffic bump. No error spikes in gateway logs, retry counts are within expected range.

jon_dev: I'm going to mark the remediation as VERIFIED in the tracker and add a note to PM-42: "Verified under short-burst smoke; stable at 2–3% miss for 30m. Reopen threshold: miss_rate >5% over 15m."

alex_sre: Acknowledged. I'll keep the alert thresholds as-is overnight and run a longer synthetic at 04:00 UTC to stress tail behavior. If anything crosses the reopen threshold I'll reopen the PM. :thumbsup:

maria_g: thanks team — handoff complete. Ping me if it reopens, otherwise enjoy the rest of day. -- maria
